usedFor: Swiftype indexes documents and Google Sheets lists them, so “New Document” can run “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document” in Swiftype, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every document added to the Swiftype index gets a row, so you can audit what was indexed.

watchOut: “New Document” in Swiftype is polling, so rows appear after a scheduled check.
